<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Happy Birthday, Queen! 👑</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--rose:#ff4d6d;--blush:#ffb3c1;--gold:#ffd166;--cream:#fff8f0;--deep:#1a0a14;--plum:#6b2d5e;}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
.clip-text{-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
body{background:var(--deep);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--cream);overflow-x:hidden;cursor:none;}
.cursor{width:16px;height:16px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;mix-blend-mode:difference;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
.cursor-trail{width:40px;height:40px;border:1.5px solid var(--rose);border-radius:50%;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;transition:transform 0.35s ease;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0.6;}
#cc{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:1000;}
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:2rem;text-align:center;}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 20% 30%,rgba(107,45,94,0.6),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 70% at 80% 70%,rgba(255,77,109,0.25),transparent 60%),var(--deep);animation:meshShift 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
@keyframes meshShift{0%{filter:hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(1);}100%{filter:hue-rotate(15deg) brightness(1.08);}}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(60px);opacity:0.45;animation:floatOrb var(--dur,10s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
.orb1{width:340px;height:340px;background:var(--plum);top:-80px;left:-80px;--dur:9s;}
.orb2{width:280px;height:280px;background:var(--rose);bottom:5%;right:-60px;--dur:12s;}
.orb3{width:180px;height:180px;background:var(--gold);top:40%;left:60%;--dur:7s;opacity:0.2;}
@keyframes floatOrb{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}100%{transform:translate(30px,40px) scale(1.12);}}
.stars{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;}
.star{position:absolute;background:white;border-radius:50%;animation:twinkle var(--t,3s) ease-in-out infinite;opacity:0;}
@keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.5);}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.4);}}
.crown-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-bottom:1.5rem;animation:crownBounce 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
.crown{font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,5.5rem);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px var(--gold));}
@keyframes crownBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg);}50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(3deg);}}
.hero-label{font-size:clamp(0.75rem,2vw,1rem);letter-spacing:0.35em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.8s 0.4s forwards;}
.hero-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,7.5rem);line-height:1.05;font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,var(--blush) 40%,var(--gold) 70%,#fff 100%);opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.65s forwards;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.hero-subtitle{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.1rem,3.5vw,2rem);color:var(--blush);margin-top:0.5rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.9s forwards;}
.divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin:2rem auto;width:min(500px,90%);opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 1.1s forwards;}
.divider-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--rose),transparent);}
.divider-icon{color:var(--rose);font-size:1.2rem;}
.message-card{max-width:680px;width:90%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,179,193,0.2);border-radius:24px;padding:clamp(1.5rem,5vw,3rem);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);position:relative;z-index:2;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 1s 1.3s forwards;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(255,77,109,0.12),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08);}
.message-card p{font-size:clamp(1rem,2.5vw,1.18rem);line-height:1.85;color:rgba(255,248,240,0.88);font-weight:300;}
.emoji-row{font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-top:1.2rem;animation:pulseEmoji 2s ease-in-out infinite;display:block;}
@keyframes pulseEmoji{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.06);}}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}
.scroll-cue{position:absolute;bottom:2rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 1s 2s forwards;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;color:rgba(255,179,193,0.6);font-size:0.78rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.scroll-arrow{width:20px;height:20px;border-right:2px solid var(--rose);border-bottom:2px solid var(--rose);transform:rotate(45deg);animation:scrollBounce 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes scrollBounce{0%,100%{transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(0);}50%{transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(6px);}}
.ribbon-banner{overflow:hidden;padding:1rem 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--plum),#3d1a36,var(--plum));border-top:1px solid rgba(255,179,193,0.15);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,179,193,0.15);white-space:nowrap;}
.ribbon-inner{display:inline-flex;gap:3rem;animation:marquee 18s linear infinite;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;}
@keyframes marquee{from{transform:translateX(0);}to{transform:translateX(-50%);}}
.gallery-section{padding:6rem 1.5rem;position:relative;}
.section-label{text-align:center;font-size:0.8rem;letter-spacing:0.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.75rem;}
.section-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,6vw,3.5rem);text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cream),var(--blush));margin-bottom:3rem;}
.photo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:1.25rem;max-width:1050px;margin:0 auto;}
.photo-card{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);}
.photo-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform 0.6s ease;}
.photo-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.07);}
.pc1{grid-column:1/8;grid-row:1;height:420px;animation:float1 5s ease-in-out infinite;}
.pc2{grid-column:8/13;grid-row:1;height:420px;animation:float2 6s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:0.4s;}
.pc3{grid-column:1/5;grid-row:2;height:340px;animation:float3 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:0.8s;}
.pc4{grid-column:5/9;grid-row:2;height:340px;animation:float1 6s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:1.2s;}
.pc5{grid-column:9/13;grid-row:2;height:340px;animation:float2 5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:0.6s;}
@keyframes float1{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-0.8deg);}50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(0.8deg);}}
@keyframes float2{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0.8deg);}50%{transform:translateY(-13px) rotate(-0.8deg);}}
@keyframes float3{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0.3deg);}50%{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(-0.3deg);}}
.photo-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px transparent;transition:box-shadow 0.4s;}
.photo-card:hover::after{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--rose),0 0 40px rgba(255,77,109,0.3);}
.photo-overlay{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(26,10,20,0.9));padding:2rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.35s;z-index:3;border-radius:0 0 22px 22px;}
.photo-card:hover .photo-overlay{opacity:1;}
.photo-caption{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--blush);}
.wishes-section{padding:5rem 1.5rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.wishes-section::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 50%,rgba(107,45,94,0.3),transparent 70%);}
.wishes-grid{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:1.25rem;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.wish-card{padding:2rem 1.75rem;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,179,193,0.15);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);transition:transform 0.35s,box-shadow 0.35s;opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);}
.wish-card.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.wish-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px)!important;box-shadow:0 25px 60px rgba(255,77,109,0.18);}
.wish-icon{font-size:2.2rem;margin-bottom:1rem;display:block;}
.wish-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.5rem;}
.wish-text{font-size:0.95rem;line-height:1.7;color:rgba(255,248,240,0.7);font-weight:300;}
.cake-section{padding:5rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;}
.cake-wrap{position:relative;display:inline-block;margin:2rem auto;}
.cake{font-size:clamp(5rem,15vw,10rem);display:block;animation:cakePop 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both,cakeFloat 3s 1s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(255,209,102,0.5));}
@keyframes cakePop{from{transform:scale(0) rotate(-20deg);opacity:0;}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}}
@keyframes cakeFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg);}50%{transform:translateY(-15px) rotate(2deg);}}
.sparkle{position:absolute;font-size:1.5rem;animation:sparkleSpin var(--s,3s) ease-in-out infinite;}
.s1{top:-10px;left:10px;--s:2.8s;}.s2{top:0;right:5px;--s:3.5s;animation-delay:0.4s;}.s3{bottom:10px;left:-15px;--s:3.1s;animation-delay:0.8s;}.s4{bottom:0;right:15px;--s:2.5s;animation-delay:1.2s;}
@keyframes sparkleSpin{0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;}50%{transform:scale(1.4) rotate(180deg);opacity:0.5;}}
.big-message{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,3.5rem);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--rose),var(--blush));margin:1rem 0 0.5rem;line-height:1.2;}
.big-sub{font-size:1.05rem;color:rgba(255,179,193,0.7);font-style:italic;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;}
.celebrate-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff4d6d,#6b2d5e);color:white;border:none;padding:1rem 2.5rem;border-radius:50px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(255,77,109,0.35);transition:transform 0.2s;margin-top:2.5rem;}
.celebrate-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
footer{padding:3rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,179,193,0.1);}
.footer-heart{font-size:1.5rem;animation:heartBeat 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block;}
@keyframes heartBeat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}20%{transform:scale(1.3);}40%{transform:scale(1);}60%{transform:scale(1.15);}}
.footer-text{margin-top:0.75rem;color:rgba(255,179,193,0.5);font-size:0.9rem;}
.particles{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;overflow:hidden;}
.particle{position:absolute;opacity:0;animation:pfly var(--d,8s) var(--delay,0s) ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes pfly{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(100vh) scale(0);}10%{opacity:0.7;}90%{opacity:0.4;}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20vh) scale(1.5);}}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .photo-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .pc1{grid-column:1/3;grid-row:1;height:260px;}
  .pc2{grid-column:1/2;grid-row:2;height:220px;}
  .pc3{grid-column:2/3;grid-row:2;height:220px;}
  .pc4{grid-column:1/2;grid-row:3;height:220px;}
  .pc5{grid-column:2/3;grid-row:3;height:220px;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="cursor" id="cursor"></div>
<div class="cursor-trail" id="cursorTrail"></div>
<canvas id="cc"></canvas>
<div class="particles" id="particles"></div>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="orb orb1"></div><div class="orb orb2"></div><div class="orb orb3"></div>
  <div class="stars" id="stars"></div>
  <div class="crown-wrap"><span class="crown">👑</span></div>
  <p class="hero-label">Today is a very special day</p>
  <h1 class="hero-title clip-text">Happy<br>Birthday!</h1>
  <p class="hero-subtitle">🎂 To my dearest friend &amp; my favorite person ❤️😍😘</p>
  <div class="divider"><div class="divider-line"></div><span class="divider-icon">✦</span><div class="divider-line"></div></div>
  <div class="message-card">
    <p>Words can't quite express how much your presence in my life means to me ☺️💕<br><br>
    You have this beautiful way of making the world brighter just by being yourself.<br><br>
    Thank you for all the shared laughs, the endless support, and the memories I'll cherish forever.<br><br>
    I hope today treats you like the absolute queen you are — Wishing you the happiest of birthdays! 🎂❤️💞</p>
    <span class="emoji-row">👑💖✨🎉🥳🌟</span>
  </div>
  <div class="scroll-cue"><span>Scroll</span><div class="scroll-arrow"></div></div>
</section>

<div class="ribbon-banner"><div class="ribbon-inner">
  <span>🎉 Happy Birthday Queen</span><span>✦</span><span>👑 You Are So Loved</span><span>✦</span><span>🌟 Shine Bright Always</span><span>✦</span><span>💖 Wishing You Joy</span><span>✦</span><span>🎂 Make a Wish</span><span>✦</span>
  <span>🎉 Happy Birthday Queen</span><span>✦</span><span>👑 You Are So Loved</span><span>✦</span><span>🌟 Shine Bright Always</span><span>✦</span><span>💖 Wishing You Joy</span><span>✦</span><span>🎂 Make a Wish</span><span>✦</span>
</div></div>

<section class="gallery-section">
  <p class="section-label">📸 She's a Whole Vibe</p>
  <h2 class="section-title clip-text">The Queen in Her Element</h2>
  <div class="photo-grid">
    <div class="photo-card pc1"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Reading on grass"><div class="photo-overlay"><p class="photo-caption">Lost in a world of books &amp; beautiful smiles ✨</p></div></div>
    <div class="photo-card pc2"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Floral dress roses"><div class="photo-overlay"><p class="photo-caption">Roses for the queen who outshines them all 🌹</p></div></div>
    <div class="photo-card pc3"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Playing guitar"><div class="photo-overlay"><p class="photo-caption">She plays music like she lives — with pure joy 🎸</p></div></div>
    <div class="photo-card pc4"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Birthday party"><div class="photo-overlay"><p class="photo-caption">Birthday girl energy — absolutely glowing 💜</p></div></div>
    <div class="photo-card pc5"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Birthday cake"><div class="photo-overlay"><p class="photo-caption">A cake as sweet as the birthday girl herself 🎂</p></div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="wishes-section">
  <p class="section-label">💌 Birthday Wishes</p>
  <h2 class="section-title clip-text" style="margin-bottom:2.5rem;">From My Heart to Yours</h2>
  <div class="wishes-grid">
    <div class="wish-card"><span class="wish-icon">🌺</span><div class="wish-title">Endless Joy</div><p class="wish-text">May every single day of this new year bring you the kind of joy that makes your heart feel full and your smile unstoppable.</p></div>
    <div class="wish-card"><span class="wish-icon">✨</span><div class="wish-title">Bright Futures</div><p class="wish-text">You have always made the world around you shine brighter. May every dream you carry finally bloom into something beautiful.</p></div>
    <div class="wish-card"><span class="wish-icon">💪</span><div class="wish-title">Unshakeable Strength</div><p class="wish-text">You are stronger than you know, more loved than you realize, and more amazing than words can describe. Never forget that.</p></div>
    <div class="wish-card"><span class="wish-icon">🎯</span><div class="wish-title">Every Goal Met</div><p class="wish-text">This year, may every door you knock on open wide. Every goal you set, achieved. Every obstacle turned into a stepping stone.</p></div>
    <div class="wish-card"><span class="wish-icon">💖</span><div class="wish-title">Love &amp; Laughter</div><p class="wish-text">May your year be filled with the people who lift you up, the moments that take your breath away, and laughter that never fades.</p></div>
    <div class="wish-card"><span class="wish-icon">👑</span><div class="wish-title">Queen Energy</div><p class="wish-text">Today and always — wear your crown. You are royalty, and this world is better because you are in it. Happy Birthday, my queen!</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="cake-section">
  <p class="section-label">🎂 Make a Wish</p>
  <div class="cake-wrap">
    <span class="cake">🎂</span>
    <span class="sparkle s1">✨</span><span class="sparkle s2">⭐</span><span class="sparkle s3">💫</span><span class="sparkle s4">🌟</span>
  </div>
  <h2 class="big-message clip-text">Wishing You the<br>Happiest of Birthdays!</h2>
  <p class="big-sub">You deserve every single good thing coming your way 💖</p>
  <button class="celebrate-btn" onclick="triggerConfetti()">🎉 Celebrate with Confetti!</button>
</section>

<footer>
  <span class="footer-heart">❤️</span>
  <p class="footer-text">Made with love · Happy Birthday, Queen 👑 · You are forever cherished</p>
</footer>

<script>
// ── Shared utilities ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const rand=(min,max)=>min+Math.random()*(max-min);          // random float in [min,max)
const chance=p=>Math.random()<p;                            // true with probability p
const pick=arr=>arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];  // random element of arr
const jitter=range=>(Math.random()-0.5)*range;              // symmetric value in [-range/2,range/2)
const centerAt=(x,y)=>`translate(${x}px,${y}px) translate(-50%,-50%)`;
function spawn(container,count,className,styleFor){
  const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const el=document.createElement('div');
    el.className=className;
    el.style.cssText=styleFor(i);
    frag.appendChild(el);
  }
  container.appendChild(frag);
}
const colors=['#ff4d6d','#ffd166','#ffb3c1','#c77dff','#fff8f0'];

const cursor=document.getElementById('cursor'),trail=document.getElementById('cursorTrail');
let mx=0,my=0,tx=0,ty=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cursor.style.transform=centerAt(mx,my);} );
(function at(){tx+=(mx-tx)*0.12;ty+=(my-ty)*0.12;trail.style.transform=centerAt(tx,ty);requestAnimationFrame(at);})();
spawn(document.getElementById('stars'),80,'star',()=>`left:${rand(0,100)}%;top:${rand(0,100)}%;--t:${rand(2,6)}s;animation-delay:${rand(0,5)}s;width:${chance(0.3)?4:2}px;height:${chance(0.3)?4:2}px;`);
spawn(document.getElementById('particles'),30,'particle',()=>`left:${rand(0,100)}%;background:${pick(colors)};--d:${rand(6,16)}s;--delay:${rand(0,8)}s;width:${rand(4,9)}px;height:${rand(4,9)}px;border-radius:${chance(0.3)?'2px':'50%'};`);
const canvas=document.getElementById('cc'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width=window.innerWidth;canvas.height=window.innerHeight;
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{canvas.width=window.innerWidth;canvas.height=window.innerHeight;});
let pieces=[],running=false;
function triggerConfetti(){
  pieces=[];
  for(let i=0;i<200;i++)pieces.push({x:rand(0,canvas.width),y:rand(-110,-30),w:rand(8,16),h:rand(5,10),color:pick(colors),angle:rand(0,Math.PI*2),spin:jitter(0.2),vx:jitter(4),vy:rand(2,6),op:1});
  if(!running){running=true;draw();}
}
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  pieces=pieces.filter(p=>p.op>0.05);
  pieces.forEach(p=>{ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(p.angle);ctx.globalAlpha=p.op;ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.fillRect(-p.w/2,-p.h/2,p.w,p.h);ctx.restore();p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.08;p.angle+=p.spin;if(p.y>canvas.height-40)p.op-=0.025;});
  if(pieces.length)requestAnimationFrame(draw);else{running=false;ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);}
}
const wishCards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.wish-card'));
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){const delay=wishCards.indexOf(e.target)*0.12;e.target.classList.add('visible');e.target.style.transition=`opacity 0.7s ${delay}s ease, transform 0.7s ${delay}s ease`;}}),{threshold:0.1});
wishCards.forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
window.addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(triggerConfetti,1800));
</script>
</body>
</html>
